cases.name: depth-positive

files.src/train.py:
import torch
from torch.nn.parallel import DistributedDataParallel
def train_and_restore(model):
    torch.distributed.init_process_group('gloo')
    distributed = DistributedDataParallel(model)
    torch.save(distributed.state_dict(), 'model.pt')
    return torch.load('model.pt')

cases.tradeoff: L3 requires attributed process-group initialization, DistributedDataParallel construction, and both checkpoint save and load in the same function component; split launch/recovery modules are missed.
